question: Rani Machaiah from Karnataka was awarded the Padma Shri for her contribution to popularising ___________ in and outside Karnataka.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ummathat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rani Machaiah from Karnataka was awarded the Padma Shri for her contribution to popularising **Ummathat** in and outside Karnataka.
 
• **Ummathat** is a traditional folk dance of the Kodava community in Karnataka.
 
• This dance form is usually performed by women and is an integral part of the cultural heritage of the Kodavas.
 
• It is performed during various festivals and celebrations, showcasing the rich cultural traditions of the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in India, given for distinguished contributions in various fields, including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Karnataka is known for its diverse cultural heritage, and traditional dance forms like **Ummathat** play a significant role in preserving this cultural legacy.
 
• Apart from Ummathat, Karnataka is also home to other traditional dance forms such as **Yakshagana, Veeragase, Dollu Kunitha,** and **Kamsale.**
